responsibility: This definition module declares a small fixed-arity vararg wrapper used inside mc to pass heterogeneous operands through a uniform interface. It provides constructors for one to four arguments, sequential access and repositioning, replacement, copying, argument counting, and destruction, chiefly supporting formatted semantic-diagnostic machinery such as mcMetaError.
same_name_distinction: This is the public definition module for the fixed-arity vararg wrapper, declaring the opaque vararg type and its constructors/accessors. Unlike varargs.mod, it does not implement the packed storage buffer, per-argument descriptors, or byte-copy mechanics.
